name: Item-mobilisation_premium
label: Mobilisation Premium
description: One-time mobilisation/demobilisation premium for this machinery item, shown in the BOQ Add Machinery dialog.

name: Item Group-has_mobilisation_fee
label: Applies Mobilisation Fee
description: Check for machinery categories that carry a mobilisation premium (e.g. Crane, Rotator / Coring Rig). Leave unchecked for categories like Excavator, Generator, or Diamond Bit that don't.

name: Quotation Item-custom_category_type
label: Row Type
description: Drives BOQ-style numbering and layout (Section / Item / Sub Item) in the printed Quotation BOQ. Set via the "Add BOQ Line" dialog, not meant to be typed directly.

name: Quotation Item-custom_amount_remark
label: Amount Remark
description: Optional text (e.g. "Included", "By Main Con") shown in place of the computed amount on the printed BOQ line.
